hard.text: Before Mrs Croft had written, he was arrived, and the very next time Anne walked out, she saw him.
She rose from breakfast before he had finished, and hastened upstairs.
But I fell asleep before I had succeeded, and dreamed of the days when I lived in my godmother's house.

hard.source: Tess of the d'Urbervilles (Hardy), LitBank 110 (trimmed clause)
hard.text: She had not set eyes on him since he had conducted her to the cottage the day before.
He felt as if tight strings which had held him had loosened themselves and let him go.
Mary remembered what he had asked her the day she had gone to his room.
I saw that the dress had been put upon the rounded figure of a young woman, and that the figure had shrunk to skin and bone.
She felt again that sensation of nausea which had come over her when she had met her first sneer.
She had mailed the letter after she had written it.

control.text: She reached the corner of the lane which they had passed half an hour earlier, and she hopped down.
She stooped to the threshold of the doorway, where she had pushed in the note two or three days earlier.
When she had first seen me she had been startled, and she looked at me steadily.
He had left his wife, and after some years of a reckless existence, she had died before her time.
Before this time he had known it but speculatively; now he thought he knew it as a practical man.
